snippet.title: Prison Legacy | First Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The first official gameplay trailer for Prison Legacy is here.

Step inside a living prison where every decision has consequences. Build alliances, choose your crime, fight tactical turn-based battles and forge your reputation in one of the most unusual MMORPGs ever created.

🎮 Coming October 2026

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860910/Prison_Legacy/

💬 Join our community on Discord:
